facts.fact: The Ministry of Communications and Technology's e-Government Strategy 2025-2029 states that the Federal Government of Somalia still has no enterprise architecture or interoperability framework, leaving digital government initiatives fragmented in silos; the statement carries no day, so the document's published date (2025-08) is used.

systems.owner: Federal Government of Somalia / Ministry of Communications and Technology
systems.tiers: federal; planned, all e-Government applications to follow it, with an Application Architecture document of standards still to be developed
federal; planned, for agency e-service platforms to exchange data
federal; planned, to integrate ministry and agency applications

note: The strategy plans a National Enterprise Architecture and an interoperability programme but records no drafting begun, so the only fact is the dated statement that no framework exists.
